Sample w20_d29cca9e1faf218662102634 | 1890 symbolically compiled gates | depth 473 | initialized, untrained
BASIS-ONLY transpilation: physical 60-qubit coupling/map is not supplied. This is not a hardware-routed acceptance figure.
One continuous left-to-right row: all 60 wires, all compiled gates and both endpoints of every CZ are displayed.
Purple θ1-θ48 gates depend on shared trainable parameters (coefficients hidden); numeric labels are fixed/encoding angles.
State preparation view. Terminal X basis adds H; server performs final Z readout. Full state preparation remains in models/stateprep.rx-rz-cz.qasm.
